data.title: Postdoctoral Fellow-MSH-32060-013
data.description: Description Salary: $75,000 Department: Medicine/Nephrology Physical work location: One Gustave L. Levy Place, Annenberg 23, New York, NY 10029 Responsibilities Details of Research Project: We are looking for highly motivated, energetic individuals to join our collaborative team at Mount Sinai and help push transplant medicine forward. Candidates will work on exciting projects in transplantation and immune-mediated kidney diseases using human samples and/or mouse models of organ transplantation. Heart transplant procedures are performed by our microsurgeon. Technical Duties: Flow-cytometry ELISA WB ELISPOT qPCR CyTOF data analyses Mouse work Qualifications Educational and other Requirements for the position: MD or PhD Experience Required: Experience handling human samples and/or mice Goals/Outcomes of the Research Project: To define the alloimmune responses in transplant recipients

data.title: Post Doctoral Fellow-MSH-32015-001
data.description: Description Department: Center for Child Health Services Research (CCHSR), Mindich Child Health and Development Institute, Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai Position Summary/Overview: The fellow will conduct NIH-funded health services and outcomes research focused on healthcare utilization, insurance coverage, healthcare expenditures, and long-term outcomes among pediatric and adult populations with complex medical conditions. Responsibilities The ideal candidate will be: Interested in health services research, healthcare policy, and cardiovascular outcomes research. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Conduct analyses of large administrative claims and clinical registry. Apply epidemiologic, biostatistical, econometric, and causal inference methods to evaluate healthcare policy impacts. Conduct literature reviews and synthesize findings from published scientific literature. Contribute to collaborative manuscripts.
